description: Drain old oil, replace oil filter, fill with fresh engine oil. Most basic maintenance.
recommended_interval: Every 3-4 months or 5,000 km — whichever comes first in PH conditions
notes: Use the correct oil viscosity for your car. Check owner's manual. PH heat degrades oil faster.

description: Replace worn brake pads. Includes inspection of brake discs. If discs are worn, additional cost applies.
recommended_interval: Every 30,000-50,000 km or when squeaking starts
notes: Always replace brakes in axle pairs (front or rear). If discs are scored or warped, replace them too. Front brakes wear faster.

description: Full brake service — new pads and new discs. Done when discs are warped, scored, or below minimum thickness.
recommended_interval: When discs are below minimum thickness or visibly damaged
notes: Metro Manila stop-and-go traffic wears brakes faster. Check brakes every 6 months.

description: Replace the car battery. Includes checking alternator output to make sure new battery won't die quickly.
recommended_interval: Every 2-3 years in PH climate. Heat kills batteries faster.
notes: Make sure alternator is charging properly before replacing. A dying alternator will kill a new battery fast.

description: Replace the alternator that charges the battery while the engine runs. Includes belt check.
recommended_interval: When charging system fails — not a scheduled service
notes: Some shops offer remanufactured alternators which are cheaper. OEM is more reliable long-term.

description: Replace the starter motor that cranks the engine when you turn the key.
recommended_interval: When starter fails — not a scheduled service
notes: Check connections first — sometimes a starter failure is just a bad ground connection.

description: Replace all spark plugs. Major impact on engine performance and fuel economy.
recommended_interval: Every 20,000-40,000 km depending on plug type. Check owner's manual.
notes: Use the correct spark plug brand and type specified in your manual. Iridium plugs last longer but cost more.

description: Replace the engine air filter. Dirty air filter reduces engine performance and fuel economy.
recommended_interval: Every 15,000-20,000 km or annually. More often if driving in dusty PH conditions.
notes: PH roads are dusty. Air filters clog faster here than in other countries. Check every 3 months visually.

description: Replace the fuel filter that cleans fuel before it reaches the engine.
recommended_interval: Every 20,000-40,000 km. More often if fuel quality is poor.
notes: PH fuel quality varies. If using cheaper fuel stations, change filter more often.

description: Drain old coolant, clean the radiator, and refill with fresh coolant. Prevents overheating.
recommended_interval: Every 1-2 years or 30,000 km
notes: PH heat stresses cooling systems hard. Do not skip this in hot months.

description: Replace the radiator if it is cracked, corroded, or clogged beyond cleaning.
recommended_interval: When radiator is damaged — not scheduled
notes: OEM radiators are more reliable but expensive. Aftermarket options available. Always flush and refill after replacement.

description: Replace the water pump that circulates coolant through the engine. Critical for preventing overheating.
recommended_interval: When pump fails — not scheduled. Usually 100,000+ km
notes: If timing belt driven, ALWAYS replace timing belt at the same time. Missing this is a common expensive mistake.

description: Drain and replace transmission fluid. Keeps automatic or manual transmission running smoothly.
recommended_interval: Every 40,000-60,000 km for automatic. Check manual.
notes: Use ONLY the fluid type specified in your owner's manual. Wrong fluid destroys transmissions.

description: Full clutch kit replacement including pressure plate and release bearing. Manual transmission cars only.
recommended_interval: Every 80,000-120,000 km or when slipping
notes: Requires transmission removal. Major job. Make sure to also check flywheel for wear.

description: Recharge the refrigerant gas in the air conditioning system. Quick fix if compressor and other parts are fine.
recommended_interval: When AC stops cooling. Not scheduled — depends on leaks.
notes: If gas keeps leaking, there is a leak in the system that needs to be found and fixed first.

description: Replace the AC compressor when it has seized or can no longer compress refrigerant.
recommended_interval: When compressor fails — not scheduled
notes: PH heat runs AC systems harder than most countries. AC maintenance is non-optional here.

description: Realign all four wheels to factory specifications. Prevents uneven tire wear and improves handling.
recommended_interval: Every 6-12 months or after hitting a major pothole
notes: PH roads have a LOT of potholes. Get alignment checked every 6 months minimum. Cheap service, big impact on tire life.

description: Repair a punctured tire. Only works if the puncture is on the tread area, not the sidewall.
recommended_interval: When punctured — emergency service
notes: If puncture is on the sidewall, tire must be replaced entirely. Do not vulcanize sidewall punctures — unsafe.

description: Replace one or more tires. Includes mounting, balancing, and inflation.
recommended_interval: Every 40,000-60,000 km or when tread depth is below safe limit
notes: Price varies by tire brand and size. Pickup trucks use bigger, more expensive tires. Always balance after mounting.

description: Replace worn shock absorbers or struts. Big improvement in ride quality on PH roads.
recommended_interval: Every 40,000-60,000 km or when ride gets bouncy
notes: Price is per unit. Most cars need 2 or 4. PH roads wear shocks faster than average. Replace in pairs (front or rear).

description: Plug an OBD scanner into the car to read all stored error codes. First step for any check engine light issue.
recommended_interval: Whenever check engine light is on
notes: Always do this FIRST before spending money on parts. The code tells you exactly what is wrong. Many shops do this for free.

description: Full maintenance package at scheduled intervals. Includes oil change, filter replacements, fluid checks, and inspection.
recommended_interval: Per manufacturer schedule — usually every 5,000-10,000 km
notes: Most dealerships offer free PMS for first 1,000 and 5,000 km. After that, ₱1,500-5,700 at casa depending on interval. Talyer is cheaper but make sure they use correct parts.

description: Replace a damaged or rusted muffler. Restores proper exhaust sound and reduces emissions.
recommended_interval: When muffler is cracked or rusted through
notes: PH road conditions (potholes, speed bumps) damage exhaust systems faster. Inspect annually.
